item.title: Revive Add-On 2.1
item.creator: Cubical
item.description:
Get a SECOND CHANCE at life with the Revive Add-On! Be revived by another player and recover your armor, items, and XP!

- NEW: Compatible with HARDCORE!
- Fully CUSTOMIZABLE: configure revive time, animations, beacons, coordinates displaying and MORE!
- Add to your OWN WORLD!

Too OP? Enable the REVIVE COST and charge players for reviving another player!

by Cubical
item.changelog:
Changes in new update:
- Totem of Undying compatibility

faqEntries.heading: Does the Revive Add-On work with Hardcore?
faqEntries.content: Yes it does! It is fully compatible with Hardcore mode and will prevent dying in Hardcode if you are revived in time.

faqEntries.heading: How does the Add-On work?
faqEntries.content: With the Revive Add-On, dying works a little differently. Instead of dying immediately, you'll enter a downed state, giving your teammates or friends a limited amount of time to revive you. To revive a downed player, simply SNEAK next to them until they're back on their feet!

faqEntries.heading: Can I customize this Add-On?
faqEntries.content: Yes! You can customize the time it takes before a player actually dies, whether coordinates should be shown in chat, animations and particles, the time it takes to revive a player, who should be notified when someone dies and you can also enable a cost in order to revive a player. All of this is controlled by the world operator(s).

faqEntries.heading: Does Revive Add-On work in singleplayer?
faqEntries.content: Yes, but you cannot revive yourself unfortunately. This Add-On is designed for multiplayer use.

item.howToTitle: How to use the Revive Add-On

howToEntries.heading: Installing & Using Revive Add-On
howToEntries.content: Install the Revive Add-On and enter your world. Once loaded, read the Revive Guide Book to learn about all the features included in the Add-On. Use the Revive Settings tool to customize the experience to fit your needs.
